metadata.short_desc: Let QQ bots display a custom menu
metadata.desc: Configure custom menu entries in AstrBot WebUI and sync them to the QQ official bot. Private chat only.

language.hint: Only affects plugin logs; user-authored menu entries are not translated.

sync_menu.hint: When disabled, the plugin only reads the current QQ menu and does not overwrite it.

qq_platforms.hint: Fill in AppID and ClientSecret; if empty, the plugin reads QQ official platforms from AstrBot platform config.

menu.hint: Click Add Entry, choose a menu type and fill in the fields. Up to 10 top-level items; for sub-menus, add a Sub-menu entry first, then add Send Message or Link entries and set Parent Menu Name to that sub-menu name.

parent.hint: Leave empty for a top-level menu; set to a Sub-menu entry name to attach this item to it.

link.hint: QQ requires https://; missing schemes are normalized to https:// automatically.

parent.hint: Leave empty for a top-level menu; set to a Sub-menu entry name to attach this item to it.
